FieldNotes.Comments: X array 45 degree rotation. Site densely vegetated with cacti, pricker bushes, and medium sized trees. Soil is moist with clay and gravel that starts below the mag hole.. South dipole line 31m, north 69m due to dense brush and cacti. Access road and small power line running EW 20m from east electrode. Lines conduited, no Russian bags. Mag cable NMC41. Battery LFP0835, 13.61 V. Hy=25
